findings.evidence: The file ends after membership and `isIntegrallyClosedIn_completedPlusSubring`; `rg completedPlusSubring code/TauCeti --glob '*.lean'` finds no order/minimality theorem, while Mathlib provides `Subring.integralClosure_subring_le_iff` in `RingTheory/IntegralClosure/IntegrallyClosed.lean:158` for exactly this universal property.
findings.fix: Add a `completedPlusSubring_le_iff` lemma reducing `completedPlusSubring … ≤ R` to `completedPlusSubringBase … ≤ R` under `[IsIntegrallyClosedIn R (UniformSpace.Completion S)]`.
findings.issue: `completedPlusSubring` has no universal-property lemma characterizing when it is contained in an integrally closed subring, so downstream minimality and uniqueness proofs must unfold its opaque implementation.

summary: Membership and integral-closedness are now exposed, but the integral closure still lacks its characteristic minimality interface.
